slides.title: Half Your Team Is Planning to Leave
slides.subtitle: The retention crisis is your opportunity

bullets: Cyber has one of the highest voluntary turnover rates in tech
Open roles fill slower when the team is in flux
Internal candidates get promoted faster during churn
Now is the best time to make yourself visible

caption: Cybersecurity has a retention problem - and that's actually good news if you play it right. The churn creates gaps. Be ready to fill them. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #careertips #jobmarket #cypherjobs
